title: The execution gap in agentic bioinformatics: a fixed-model comparison of the Biomni, Galaxy and smarts.bio tool servers against an untooled control
description:
The same model (claude-opus-5) answering the same 48 prompts through one platform's MCP tool server at a time, or through none at all. Four conditions, listed alphabetically rather than by outcome: Biomni, Galaxy, smarts.bio, and an untooled control. Scored 0-3 by a rubric judge blinded to condition, with a separate audit layer; 46 tasks per condition after two defective tasks are excluded.

Disclosure: this benchmark was designed, executed, graded and audited by smarts.bio, which is one of the conditions under comparison. The task set is released as it was run, the judge was blinded, the categories where smarts.bio loses are reported, and every figure can be recomputed from the released files with analyze.py.

The archive contains the frozen task set with rubrics and ground truth, the run-level record for all 195 runs, both audit layers, the raw transcript of every run including those that failed, the input fixtures, the measurement harness and the paper.

Licensing is split: code is MIT; the task set, run record, transcripts and results are CC BY 4.0. Some fixtures are third-party public records redistributed under their own terms, listed in the README under "Fixture provenance".
